world_name.title: World Name
world_name.description: This becomes the live world save identity loaded by the dedicated server under this instance's managed Necesse saves root.

max_slots.title: Max Players
max_slots.description: Dedicated server slot count. Necesse currently accepts values from 1 to 250.

motd.title: Message of the Day
motd.description: Shown to joining players. Use \n if you want line breaks in the dedicated server message.

owner_name.title: Owner Player Name
owner_name.description: Player name that should automatically receive owner permissions when joining this server. LanGame materializes it into the native launch plan as -owner when non-empty and omits -owner when blank. Current dedicated-server builds ignore owner names containing '-' characters, so use the real in-game name you actually join with and avoid hyphens.

password.title: Join Password
password.description: Join gate for the room. Clear it only if you intentionally want an open server.

pause_when_empty.title: Pause When Empty
pause_when_empty.description: Pause world simulation whenever no players are currently online.

strict_server_authority.title: Enable Server Authority Checks
strict_server_authority.description: Makes the dedicated server validate client actions more strictly.

logging_enabled.title: Write Session Logs
logging_enabled.description: Create a native Necesse log file for each dedicated-server session under the instance data root.

zip_saves.title: Compress World Saves
zip_saves.description: Keep the live world as a .zip save file under this instance's managed saves root.

language.title: Server Language
language.description: Language code for occasional server-side messages and log text.

ignore_seasons.title: Disable Seasonal Content
ignore_seasons.description: Turn off seasonal event content on this dedicated server.

custom_launch_flags.title: Advanced: Custom Launch Flags
custom_launch_flags.description: Additional Necesse launch flags appended to the launch plan.

max_client_latency_seconds.title: Maximum Client Latency (seconds)
max_client_latency_seconds.description: Disconnect timeout; native default is 30 seconds. Leave unset to preserve the current native value.

unload_levels_cooldown.title: Level Unload Delay (seconds)
unload_levels_cooldown.description: How long a level remains loaded after the last player leaves; native default is 30 seconds. Leave unset to preserve the current native value.

dropped_items_life_minutes.title: Dropped Item Lifetime (minutes)
dropped_items_life_minutes.description: Zero or less keeps items indefinitely; native default is 0. Leave unset to preserve the current native value.

unload_settlements.title: Unload Empty Settlements
unload_settlements.description: Allow inactive settlements to unload; native default is disabled. Leave unset to preserve the current native value.

max_settlements_per_player.title: Settlements per Player
max_settlements_per_player.description: Minus one or less allows unlimited settlements; native default is -1. Leave unset to preserve the current native value.

max_settlers_per_settlement.title: Settlers per Settlement
max_settlers_per_settlement.description: Minus one or less allows unlimited settlers; native default is -1. Leave unset to preserve the current native value.

world_border_size.title: Island travel boundary
world_border_size.description: Applies only to worlds with island-coordinate spawn locations, not the seamless world introduced in 1.0. -1 removes the boundary; 0 allows only the spawn island; positive values limit island-coordinate distance from spawn on either axis. Leave unset to preserve the native value.
